description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the Tree Builder functionality within a documentation system, specifically creating and verifying directory structures and their contents using virtual filesystems.

classes.name: BuilderIntegrationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the hierarchical building of directory and content objects within the documentation system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up a virtual filesystem structure with sample directories and markdown files for use in tests.

methods.name: testCreateHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the creation of a directory tree structure using the Builder and verifies the presence and types of entries and related properties.
